prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for Embergrave, a gothic isometric dark fantasy RPG. Create ONE square 2048x2048 atlas with exactly 16 isolated detailed painted sprites in a precise 4-column by 4-row equal grid. Every 512x512 cell must have generous transparent padding, no sprite crossing its cell, centered object, slight isometric top-down 30-degree view, subdued realistic metal/stone/parchment, silver-black and ember red-gold, not cartoon. This is world artwork, NO text, labels, frames, background, contact sheet decoration or cast rectangular shadow. Row 1 left-to-right: an assembled jagged Sunderstone core of black-red crystal fragments with internal ivory-gold light; the same core visibly cracked into still-connected segments with brighter fissures; one long black-red shard used to strike the core; a smaller rough broken black-red crystal fragment. Row 2: open aged transport ledger with shipping columns and faint ink lines but no readable writing; unfolded aged fortress map depicting floating gothic cathedral islands and connecting bridges; cult gateway plan parchment with a buried palace and an ominous portal diagram; old carved golden ward medallion. Row 3: ancient dark stone reliquary with carved ward seals, OPEN with empty cavity; the SAME reliquary CLOSED; a broken length of heavy iron binding chain; clustered small chipped stone and crystal debris. Row 4: luminous gothic portal arch made of black metal and gold light around a genuinely TRANSPARENT open center; small floating gothic cathedral silhouette/projection with several islands; distressed old imperial inscription stone tablet; tiny cluster of pale human soul faces in smoky translucent folds. Transparent background and transparent spaces around all sprites. High-quality hand-painted game art. No people, no UI.
prompts.warden: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Create a production sprite atlas for live cinematic animation in Embergrave. The attached image is ONLY the character identity/style reference: preserve Seraneth's long straight silver hair, pale angular face, blue-grey silver ceremonial armor, white-blue long cloak, dark gauntlets and gothic realism. ONE transparent square 2048x2048 atlas, EXACT 4 columns by 2 rows of equal 512x1024 cells. 8 full-body poses of the SAME figure, consistent size and feet baseline near bottom of each cell, all facing 3/4 towards lower-left of image so hands reach left. Full figure, hands and cloak inside each cell with generous transparent padding. Row 1: calm attentive idle; looking down examining an open small ledger held in both hands; extending empty palms towards a companion on left; taking a small glowing black-gold crystal core in cupped hands. Row 2: holding the same core at chest level, eyes subtly lit ivory-gold; a restrained nod while holding the core; turning away with core and cloak moving; kneeling in exhaustion with one hand reaching left (wounded but recognizable). Detailed painted game art with grounded anatomy, realistic heavy fabric and metal. No wings, halos, unrelated weapons, text, cell borders, scenery, duplicate people in a cell, opaque background or contact shadows.
prompts.people: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent animation sprite atlas for Embergrave, gothic isometric RPG, detailed hand-painted realistic people, muted earth colors, view looking down 30 degrees. ONE square 2048x2048 with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows of equal 512x512 cells, single full-body person centered in each cell at consistent scale with feet near the bottom and generous transparent padding. Row 1 is SAME aged male archivist Ilyan in sand-beige robes and desaturated blue sash, grey hair and short beard, no weapons: columns bound kneeling with wrists together; released crouch one hand supporting on ground; standing upright tired; standing pointing with right hand toward upper-right. Row 2 SAME silent marsh villager woman in faded brown long dress with dark pinned hair: columns neutral standing; left foot forward walk; right foot forward walk; turning head towards upper-right. Row 3 SAME silent marsh villager young man in weathered grey tunic and dark trousers: same four poses. Row 4 SAME elderly marsh villager woman with worn grey-green shawl and brown dress: same four poses. Villagers face upper-right in three-quarter profile in all walk poses, arms hang loosely, blank calm expressions, no fear or action gesture. Grounded natural stride, each character consistent across their row. Separate figures with no overlapping cells. Completely transparent surrounding background. No text, grid borders, decorations, ground, rectangular shadows, blood or cartoon style.
prompts.walkers: Use case: stylized-concept. New production sprite atlas for gothic game Embergrave. Use attached picture only as reference for the three villagers' faces, clothes, painted style and view angle. THIS NEW ATLAS IS ONLY WALKING VILLAGERS, no scholar or kneeling or sitting or bound poses. Exact 4 columns and 3 rows on a square transparent image, each cell one separate full standing full-body person, generous transparent padding, feet near each row baseline. ROW 1 the dark-haired woman in brown long dress from reference row 2. ROW 2 the young man in grey tunic and brown trousers from reference row 3. ROW 3 the old grey-haired woman in grey-green shawl and brown dress from reference row 4. In EVERY ROW columns left to right: standing calm idle; walking with LEFT leg visibly stepping forward; walking with RIGHT leg visibly stepping forward; standing calm turned head. Every figure upright. All face upper-right in 3/4 profile, natural unhurried gait, arms loose, empty calm expressions. Keep each person's identity and outfit exactly consistent across four poses. Detailed painterly realistic dark-fantasy world art, 30 degree downward isometric camera. No ground or shadows, background entirely transparent. No text, grid borders, props, seated/kneeling people, restraints or action gestures.
prompts.warriors: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Production cinematic pose atlas for Embergrave gothic isometric RPG. Attached reference defines an Oathsworn warrior: pale grey unremembering face, long grey hair, weathered dark iron plate with leather and fur, heavy grounded realistic anatomy. Create ONE transparent square sprite atlas EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows of equally sized cells. Every cell contains ONE complete full-body warrior; generous empty transparent padding, each row the SAME person and same weapon, consistent proportions and grounded feet baseline, perspective viewed down 30 degrees. All face three-quarter lower-left. Row 1 is an axe warrior with single dark iron axe. Row 2 is a spear warrior with long dark iron spear. Row 3 is a sword warrior with broad heavy iron sword. The 4 columns in EACH row show in order: kneeling dormant head down with weapon resting; rising to feet with one knee bent and weapon low; standing alert weapon held ready; standing raising weapon toward a hero at lower-left in a solemn threatening guard. This is a deliberate awakening and confrontation, not a combat swing. No cast shadows, scenery, ground, labels, frames, text, fog or opaque background. No sprites touching other cells. Painterly realistic gothic game art matching the reference, restrained colors, high detail, not a cartoon.
